description: List saved client scenarios for the account, newest first.
name: list_scenarios

count.description: Number of items in the array above. There is no pagination on this route — this is the complete set for the org, not a page.

scenarios.description: The scenarios visible to the API key making the call. Empty when the org has none; the MCP layer wraps the upstream array so the result is always an object.

items.description: A saved scenario: a stored decision input plus the result snapshot captured when it was saved.
